blocks.summary: Problem (causal multi-stage pipelines, error accumulation), BiWM two-stage bidirectional-autoregressive full-stack framework, backbones, history compression, NVFP4, anti-degradation objectives. 3 Para pairs.

Interactive world model goal; causal vs bidirectional families; KV-cache frozen-error argument incl. footnote 1; language-vs-video-diffusion drift contrast; minWM gap; BiWM recipe overview; academic budget; contributions. 7 Para pairs.

Diffusion backbones (3 families); causal interactive WMs (CausVid/Self-Forcing/minWM); bidirectional WMs (Yume, Matrix-Game-3.0); camera injection absolute vs relative; distillation/GAN/memory schemes. 6 Para pairs.
Two-stage pipeline statement; chunk factorization Eq. 1; causal vs bidirectional autoregression definition (frozen KV vs refreshed history). 1 + 3 Para pairs.

blocks.section: 3.2 Data Preprocessing: Camera Trajectories to Discrete Actions
blocks.summary: Continuous 6-DoF grounding; OpenVid+WorldPlay prescribed trajectories; Sekai real footage with SLAM/ViPE-style annotation; filtering and static-only captioning; quantization handoff to Eq. 2. 5 Para pairs.

Camera control as pure text-space conditioning; Eq. 2 (81-class label), Eq. 3 (one-time pre-encoding), Eq. 4 (per-frame condition assembly, S=512, NN interpolation), Eq. 5-6 (decoupled per-frame vs memory streams); parameter efficiency, ~100-step control emergence. 6 Para pairs.

blocks.section: 3.4 Chunk-wise Autoregressive Rollout and History Conditioning
blocks.summary: Single memory-token interface; sink-based sliding window; PackForcing-style HR+LR encoder (8 causal 3D-conv blocks, 64-512 channels); Yume-1.5-style FramePack pyramid (scales 1-16); patch-unit RoPE convention. 5 Para pairs.

Self-Forcing-based self-rollout DMD in bidirectional setting; flow-matching parameterization; Eq. 7 DMD gradient; Eq. 8 GAN hinge; Eq. 9 SFT low-sigma anchor; Eq. 10-11 real/teacher forward-KL anchors; Eq. 12 total objective; real-time event editing (Fig. 5); training-free I2V (Fig. 6); mixed-task training. 8 Para pairs.
Same recipe on cross-attention (Wan2.1/2.2), MMDiT (HunyuanVideo-1.5), audio-video (LTX-2.3-22B) backbones; thin-adapter porting. 1 Para pair.

blocks.section: 3.7 Training Budget and Optional Low-Bit Inference
blocks.summary: ~100 + ~200 optimizer steps on 8xH200; FP8-E4M3/NVFP4 pathway; QAT with quantization self-distillation via forward-KL on velocity and x0-hat; honest low-bit caveats. 3 Para pairs.

77-frame clips, static-only captions, one-time pre-encoding, NN action alignment, single-gradient-step rollout, chunk-count curriculum, flag-toggled losses, released figure-generation and fine-tuning scripts. 2 Para pairs.

Framework characterized by component function; quantitative study explicitly ongoing; instantiation details (77 frames -> 20 latent frames, 4 steps/chunk); qualitative analyses of Figs. 7, 2, 8, 9. 1 + 3 + 4 Para pairs.
Recipe summary (50-step teacher -> 4-step generator, 81-class vocabulary); breadth across backbones; positioning vs minWM; future directions. 2 Para pairs.
